items.claim: The row's Hebrew quotes are unlabeled skeleton tier, and its "antithetic bicolon" call undersells the Hebrew's non-adversative structure.
items.evidence: collate.py --json against oshb:Prov.11.10/oshb:Prov.11.11 returns tier=skeleton (status GREEN, no niqqud) for both quoted forms קריה and קרת, never disclosed as skeleton-tier in prose. Separately, 11:10's two cola both report POSITIVE city reactions (rejoicing / shouting) to different causes rather than one colon negating the other -- the classic antithetic pattern of 11:11 (exalt vs. overthrow) is absent here; WEB itself carries no ", but" at 11:10 (confirmed against the antithetic_texture inventory), so "antithetic" is a stretch for a synthetic/synonymous civic-reaction pair.

items.claim: The row's Hebrew quotes are unlabeled skeleton tier, and an exact-token echo with its own successor verse (11:19) goes undisclosed on both sides of that seam.
items.evidence: collate.py --json against oshb:Prov.11.18 returns tier=skeleton (GREEN) for עשה פעלת שקר and זרע צדקה שכר אמת. Independently, sweep.py --skel "צדקה" hits Prov.11.18 and Prov.11.19 as an adjacent pair (15 verses book-wide total) -- a byte-true token straddling this row's own seam with its successor that is not named here (CROSS-SEAM COHESION hazard, live in chs 10-29). It does not overturn the single_proverb call by itself (11:18's sow/reap wage-image and 11:19's synthetic conclusion-clause remain formally distinct units), but it should have been disclosed.

items.claim: The row explicitly and falsely claims 11:18 and 11:19 "share no repeated wording," undercounts the cross-referenced occurrences of its cited noun, and its own quotes are unlabeled skeleton tier.
items.evidence: sweep.py --skel "צדקה" shows the exact skeleton token present in BOTH Prov.11.18 and Prov.11.19 (15 verses book-wide, both refs adjacent in the hit list) -- directly contradicting the row's rejected_alternative ("the two verses share no lexical catchword") and rationale ("though the two verses share no repeated wording"). Separately, sweep.py --skel "לחיים" returns 4 verses book-wide (Prov.10.16, Prov.10.17, Prov.11.19, Prov.19.23), not the 2 implied by "its other occurrence at the Prov.10.16-Prov.10.17 cluster" -- Prov.19.23 is a third, unmentioned site carrying the identical prefixed form. Both quoted runs (כן; לחיים) collate at skeleton tier only (collate.py, GREEN) and carry no tier label.
